newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal inaugurates $1.9 billion natgas pipeline.
newsitem.headline: Portugal inaugurates $1.9 billion natgas pipeline.

text.p: Prime Minister Antonio Guterres inaugurated a $1.88 billion pipeline carrying natural gas from Algeria at a ceremony near Pombal in central Portugal on Thursday, officials said.
State company Transgas will deliver natural gas to regional distributors and industrial companies, and will supply the Tapada power plant in northern Portugal in October 1997, they said.

Domestic consumers will have to wait another two months before receiving the natural gas due to delays in setting up the regional distribution network in Portugal, Portuguese TSF radio reported from the ceremony.
Construction of the pipeline, which brings natural gas to Portugal via Morocco and Spain, was completed last November.
